beats.line: But it gets even worse. The guards outside the cell
wear cushioned shoes to silence their steps
ensuring that you never hear a single sound from the outside world
You see, the color white wasn't chosen because the guards are fans of minimalist design
White completely eliminates contrast, depth, and visual reference points
And since your brain is getting absolutely zero stimulation from the outside world
it eventually begins to create its own
Within a few days your mind begins to glitch itself
and terrifying noises that are not actually there
